participant_1.name: Emily
participant_1.personality: Creative and nurturing, Emily enjoys sharing her love for music with others. She is passionate about helping those in need.
participant_1.background: I volunteer at the homeless shelter. My father played violin professionally. I enjoy exploring new parts of the city. I am a piano teacher on the side. I play several instruments.

participant_2.name: Liam
participant_2.personality: Energetic and determined, Liam is highly focused on his fitness and health. His experience as a cancer survivor has made him resilient and motivated.
participant_2.background: I am a clean eater. My parents were both very athletic. I love running and preparing for marathons. I am a cancer survivor.
